topic: 3 things that happen when you spend 4 hours on Google Maps for 5 leads

hooks.text: Freelancers: 3 ways Google Maps wastes your billable hours
Freelancers, still scrolling leads at 9 am? Why?
Freelancers: Myth – more searching = more clients. Fact: It’s opposite.

posts.linkedin:
Freelancers waste billable hours searching for local business leads on Google Maps.

Each morning you open Maps, type a category, click every pin, and copy phone numbers into a document.

By midday you have a few names and no pitches, and the mental fatigue reduces the time you could spend on client work.

I created an automated script that extracts newly opened local businesses from Google Places, including phone numbers, review counts, and website status, and places them in a simple spreadsheet.

Whether you offer marketing, video, design, accounting, or any other service, the ready list lets you start outreach right away.

Message me with the word LEADS and tell me what you sell to local businesses.

𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗨𝗔𝗟 𝗦𝗘𝗔𝗥𝗖𝗛𝗜𝗡𝗚 on Google Maps eats your billable hours before you send one pitch.

I pull local business data via Google Places into a clean sheet. Whatever you sell, start pitching at 9 am.

DM 𝗟𝗘𝗔𝗗𝗦 for a 1-minute explanation.

replies.if_they_say: How much does the lead sheet cost?
replies.reply: Hi! Thanks for reaching out. The pricing depends on your target location and how frequently you need fresh lists. Quick question: what service do you sell, and which cities are you targeting?

replies.if_they_say: Do you provide leads for my specific service or niche?
replies.reply: The script pulls local businesses found via Google Places across any category you choose, including their phone numbers, review counts, and website status. What service do you offer, and who is your ideal local business client?

replies.if_they_say: Can you share a free sample sheet to test?
replies.reply: I don't provide custom sample files, but I can share a quick 1-minute explanation of exactly what columns and data points the sheet includes. Tell me what service you sell, and I will let you know honestly if this setup fits your outreach.
